competences: The learner identifies the term's source-grounded facts about revision: the government of uganda.
The learner answers questions about Revision and practice correctly.
languageCompetence: Reads and spells words associated with government, legislature, executive, judiciary.
objectives: By the end of the period, learners should be able to identify the sourced facts about revision: the government of uganda.
By the end of the period, learners should be able to answer the available original questions on Revision and practice.
priorKnowledge: Learners have studied SST topics about independent Uganda, the government and population during this term. They use their earlier notes while reviewing revision: the government of uganda.
materials: SST revision chart on revision: the government of uganda
P5 SST reference notes and original exercise questions
references: P.5 Social Studies Lesson Notes Term III: Uganda as an Independent Nation

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher introduces revision: the government of uganda and reviews relevant earlier Primary Five work. They ask "State tany three ways the legislature in a democratic government." and connect the replies with the original source material.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners recall prior SST knowledge, answer the opening question and identify the earlier topics that relate to the new work.

steps.content: The executive , legislative and judiciary are the arms of the government, under what arm of the government do the following belongs: This is the ruling organ of the government It is the organ of the government which is responsible for the day today running of the affairs of the country. It implements government policies. Civil servants (government workers) Establishment of many government and private universities e.g. Mbarara university, Bugema university, Mbale university , KIU etc Corruption in some government departments. Inspector general of government (IGG) In which one way did Amin’s government violate human rights The National (central) government. Local council I Village Cell LC I They are all under the National government. This is the government that bears all the major responsibilities towards the people in a country. Differences between the central government and local government Central government Local government It is one government. There are many local governments.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher writes and explains the source-grounded facts on revision: the government of uganda, starting with "The executive , legislative and judiciary are the arms of the government, under what arm of the government do the following belongs:; This is the ruling organ of the government". They ask learners to explain the stated information and relate it to the current revision topic.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners read the original content, respond to teacher questions, identify relevant facts and copy or correct their revision notes.

steps.content: State tany three ways the legislature in a democratic government. | State one function of the executive arm of government. | Give one role of the judiciary arm of the government. How is a government important to | How does the Legislature help the Judiciary to perform its work? | Give one achievement made by the NRM government in Uganda.
steps.teacherActivity: The teacher sets the original questions, including "State tany three ways the legislature in a democratic government." and "State one function of the executive arm of government.". They monitor answers, support learners who need help and correct responses using the accepted source pack.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer the sourced exercise independently, explain their reasoning and correct any answers that do not match the factual notes.

steps.teacherActivity: The teacher summarises revision: the government of uganda using the recorded facts, then checks understanding with "State tany three ways the legislature in a democratic government.". They ask "State one function of the executive arm of government." and allocate remaining questions for further revision.
steps.learnerActivity: Learners answer the concluding oral questions, mention one useful fact and complete corrections in their exercise books.

assessment: Use the original questions "State tany three ways the legislature in a democratic government." and "State one function of the executive arm of government.", with the remaining sourced exercise, to check individual learners' understanding. Mark against the source facts.
homework: Revise and complete the remaining original questions including "Why did the government of president Museveni introduce UPE?"
